name: Custom Deli Turkey & Provolone on Sourdough Bread
whyItWorks: At the made-to-order deli station, slicing lean oven-roasted turkey and aged provolone (low lactose) onto soft artisan sourdough bread creates an easily digested, protein-rich meal with zero irritating raw vegetables.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order turkey and provolone on sourdough. Skip raw onions, tomatoes, lettuce, hot peppers, and spicy mustard. Mayonnaise or light olive oil is usually tolerated.
